_note: The second frozen set: the ten scenarios of dataset 2.1. Suite v1 (the
fifteen scenarios of dataset 2.0) is unchanged; published numbers cite
whichever suite they were computed on.
Coverage is 65 of 70 combinations: move_flower_hand has two-segment
episodes, below the structural minimum for next_action (no real
distractor besides the answer), frame_match/view_match (no third
distractor frame outside the anchor segment) and frame_order (fewer
than three adjacent segments). Its five empty dimensions are kept and
reported as n/a rather than dropped: an honest partial scenario over a
name: RoboChrono-v2
